stemMd: A reviewer recommends a product only when it is durable and repairable. Every durable, repairable product that also uses standard spare parts receives a recommendation. Which statement is supported?

options.label: A
options.textMd: A recommended product may be neither durable nor repairable.

options.label: B
options.textMd: No repairable product can be rejected.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Only products with standard spare parts can be recommended.

options.label: D
options.textMd: A recommended product must be durable, but need not be shown to use standard spare parts.

explanationMd: Separate necessary conditions from a sufficient package. Recommendation requires durability and repairability. Standard spare parts help guarantee recommendation when combined with them, but are not stated to be required for every recommendation.

distractorRationale.e: Repairability and possibly further conditions remain relevant.
distractorRationale.c: Standard parts appear in a sufficient condition, not a necessary one.
